INVITING, PLUSH, SPACIOUS, THOUGHTFUL and endlessly accommodating. You could say the
Jeep Grand Cherokee interior is less “cabin” and more “world-class luxury destination.” Generously sized for
®
up to seven people and up to 84.6 cubic feet of cargo room, it features lush surfaces, available 16-way seat
adjustments, available memory presets, an available massage mode and available multicolor ambient LED
mood lighting. Luxury home audio company, McIntosh,® provides an available 17-channel amplifier delivering
up to 950 watts of power through 19 custom-designed speakers and a 10-inch subwoofer. Superior
connectedness and GPS Navigation8 are delivered by the all-new Uconnect® 5 NAV system’s larger
12.3-inch touchscreen, now standard on every Grand Cherokee. A class-exclusive, available
front-passenger interactive touchscreen display9 gives your co-pilot their own screen to help with navigation
and entertainment selections, while the available 10-inch Head-Up Display projects essential driver
information at eye level on the windshield.
